dragon_knight_dragon_blood.name: Dragon Blood
dragon_knight_dragon_blood.description:
The life blood of the Dragon improves Dragon Knight's health regeneration and armor.  

Regen and armor are increased by %regen_and_armor_multiplier_during_dragon_form%%% during Elder Dragon Form.
dragon_knight_dragon_blood.facet_dragon_knight_corrosive_dragon: Attacks are filled with lethal poison that affects enemy units and structures, reducing armor and dealing physical damage over time.
dragon_knight_dragon_blood.facet_dragon_knight_fire_dragon: Attacks deal additional magic damage to enemy units. Spells and items have increased AoE.
dragon_knight_dragon_blood.facet_dragon_knight_frost_dragon: Attacks are filled with frost that affects enemy units, slowing movement speed, attack speed, and reducing health restoration.
dragon_knight_dragon_blood.lore: Slyrak's blood still courses through Davion's veins, giving him twice the vitality of an ordinary knight.

dragon_knight_breathe_fire.name: Breathe Fire
dragon_knight_breathe_fire.description: Unleashes a breath of fire in front of Dragon Knight that burns enemies and reduces the damage their attacks deal.
dragon_knight_breathe_fire.lore: Knight Davion's breath has become that of the mighty Eldwurm Slyrak, remembered for burning numerous other knights to a crisp.
dragon_knight_breathe_fire.note0: Hits creatures at a slightly greater distance.

dragon_knight_dragon_tail.name: Dragon Tail
dragon_knight_dragon_tail.description: Dragon Knight smites an enemy unit with his shield, stunning and damaging it and units close to it.
dragon_knight_dragon_tail.lore: Davion's combination of dragon talents and knightly skills makes him a vicious opponent in melee combat.

dragon_knight_elder_dragon_form.name: Elder Dragon Form
dragon_knight_elder_dragon_form.description:
Dragon Knight assumes the form of the Elder Dragon, increasing the range of his abilities, gaining bonus movement speed, and a ranged attack with various properties.  The Dragon evolves per level. The bonuses are cumulative. 

Level 1 <font color='#9acd32'>Green</font>: Grants a corrosive damage over time that can also damage buildings.

Level 2 <font color='#FF0000'>Red</font>: Grants splash damage to the dragon's attacks.

Level 3 <font color='#87ceeb'>Blue</font>: Grants a debuff immunity piercing movement and attack frost slow on attack.
dragon_knight_elder_dragon_form.scepter_description: Increases the current level of Dragon Form by one. Adds a Level 4 Black Dragon that has free pathing, bonus magic resistance, and increased other bonuses.
dragon_knight_elder_dragon_form.lore: The power of the ancient dragon that lies dormant within Davion is unleashed, combining the power of a legendary knight with the power of a legendary dragon.
dragon_knight_elder_dragon_form.note0: The damage from poison attacks is lethal.
dragon_knight_elder_dragon_form.note1: The cooldown of some items depends on what type of attack the hero had when using them.
